title: Townsend Brown and Ning Li claims of weight reduction and gravitational shielding

tellings.quote: a bunch of people over the last 70 years the foremost in my mind Towns and Brown and you know this uh Ningly at University of Alabama Huntsville saying that they're getting little weight reduction effects gravitational shielding

plain: Over the past seventy years, several people have claimed small reductions in weight and a kind of gravitational shielding, meaning a way to block or lessen gravity's pull. Michels names the two he thinks of first: a researcher named Thomas Townsend Brown and a researcher named Ning Li at the University of Alabama in Huntsville. He raises it on his own, without citing their papers, as a hint that gravity might be engineered.
